snippet.title: Forgotlings Launches on PS5 & Xbox Series X|S June 18!
snippet.description:
We’re thrilled to finally announce that our award-winning indie adventure Forgotlings is coming to PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S on June 18! ✨🎮

In addition to being available on Steam, Forgotlings will also launch on the Epic Games Store and GOG on the same day! ✨

Set sail across the seas of the Forgotten Lands, unite a fractured world against a common threat, and experience this cinematic adventure from the comfort of your couch.  🌊

We can’t wait for you to play! 

-----------------------------------------------

🎮 Play Forgotlings on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/

🎬 Watch the Forgotlings Launch Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k1r4PA0HBtU

✨ Learn more about Forgotlings:
https://www.throughlinegames.com/forgotlings

💬 Join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/kYBN8B2YhJ

📣 Keep up-to-date with the latest news on Forgotlings via our socials:
X/Twitter: https://x.com/ThroughlineGame
Facebook: https://facebook.com/throughlinegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/throughlinegames/
